question: Which document conversion laws should DOCX file import, export and Word paste share, and where must fidelity limits be explicit?
trigger: The owner asked for a best-api-review audit of every open ledger unit, frozen from status at fe0e9599a6 on 2026-10-04 (39 units), and judged afresh because earlier verdicts came from a weaker model. It asked for verdicts only, so no plan, build or panel follows in this run. This scope was open as pursue-unbound at queue position 11. It is not the unit next returned, which was reads.
requirements: Import a bounded untrusted DOCX into one schema-valid document or an explicit failure, with structured diagnostics for every loss.
Export one captured editor revision under an explicit accepted, proposed or review projection, with Word revisions and comments as format-native output.
Opt-in retained source returns original bytes only for an eligible unchanged review export and never bypasses output safety.
Word clipboard paste stays a separate plugin with its own lifecycle and entrypoint.
Hidden native state inside a semantic interchange format needs a proven current caller and one authority; exact Plate state uses canonical persistence (Best API rule and Plate vision).
Comment storage and Word author identity mapping stay application-owned.
evidenceReuse: Reused the 2026-09-15 retained-source implementation record, the 2026-09-26 HTML/Markdown envelope hard cut, the 2026-09-27 exports adversarial deferral and the 2026-09-28/29 conversion-boundary eligibility and safety adoption. On the live tree, rechecked the public import/export option and result types, source.ts, sourceEligibility.ts, correspondence.ts, packageArtifacts.ts, the envelope read path in importDocx.ts, the registry import/export toolbars and docx-source provider, docx.mdx and authored-changes.mdx, and ran a repository-wide git grep for nativeState and authoredTrust consumers. No file under packages/platejs/src/docx or the DOCX registry/docs files is uncommitted.
summary: The job is one truthful DOCX import, edit and export workflow plus a separate Word paste adapter, with every loss diagnosed. Live source has adopted the old Pursue and its later refinements. importDocx(source, { plugins, ... }) returns one document or a failure, exportDocx captures one snapshot under an explicit projection, DocxSource is opt-in, nullable and eligibility-checked, output passes a safety gate, and WordPastePlugin owns paste. The material remainder is the hidden native envelope. exportDocx can attach editor/authored.json, and importDocx with authoredTrust lets it win. Its manifest hashes every package part, so any Word or LibreOffice save discards it, and the only working path is a Plate-to-Plate transfer that canonical authored JSON already owns. The signature trust mode has no producer at all. The 2026-09-27 exports review deferred this cut pending a decision on a single-file exact-round-trip job. No caller for that job exists in the repository, so this review's fresh decision is to cut it. Keeping it costs a public trust API, digest machinery, a diagnostic family and an extra eligibility vocabulary entry for no current user.

callSites.current: const result = await exportDocx(editor, { projection: 'review', nativeState: 'attach' }); // writes editor/authored.json. const imported = await importDocx(file, { plugins, authoredTrust: { kind: 'same-application' } }); // the hidden document wins only if every package part is byte-identical
callSites.proposed: const result = await exportDocx(editor, { projection: 'review' }); // Word revisions and comments only. const exact = JSON.stringify(projectAuthoredReview(editor.read.value()).review); // canonical authored JSON holds exact Plate review state. const imported = await importDocx(file, { plugins }); // always derived from visible OOXML. Proposed removals: nativeState, authoredTrust, DocxAuthoredTrust, native-data-ignored, editor/authored.json.

alternatives: Keeping the envelope as an explicit opt-in (the current design) loses. It has zero production callers, it survives only byte-identical Plate-to-Plate transfers, and it keeps a trust API, digest machinery and a second exact-state authority.

The selected option hard-cuts nativeState, authoredTrust, DocxAuthoredTrust, the native-data-ignored diagnostic, the editor/authored.json writer and reader and its correspondence digests, and exact review state uses canonical authored JSON. It deletes a duplicate persistence channel without losing a current user job.

Making the envelope survive Word saves through semantic rather than byte correspondence loses. It needs a second matcher over Word-rewritten XML to decide which authority wins, which is more machinery for a job no caller has.

Deleting DocxSource retained source as well loses. The conversion-boundary D1 gate measured 87% of repository fixtures eligible and byte-identical, and the first-party import-edit-export toolbar uses it.

Moving Word comment thread adoption from the copied import/export toolbars into platejs/comments is the next-strongest candidate, but not now. A reasoned prior decision makes author identity mapping app policy, DocxComment already carries ranges, replies and resolution, and the registry is the only consumer. Reopen it under the comments scope when a second consumer copies the mapping.

Replacing file conversion with a universal document engine or an OOXML canonical model is a Stop, as every prior review found. DOCX files, Word paste, HTML, Markdown and authored JSON keep distinct jobs and owners.
proofLimits: This audit was a source review only, with no test, build, browser, Word or LibreOffice run. This review infers from per-part byte digests that a Word re-save invalidates the envelope and did not observe it. The caller search covered only this repository, so external consumers are unknown. The decision page documents-conversion-fidelity.md still shows the pre-September-25 call shape (importDocx(model, bytes), exportToDocx, non-null source) and needs reconciliation. Body media ingestion, multi-section headers and footers, body XML retention after edits and Word-paste image and table geometry remain outside the claim, and this review does not reopen them.
